name: ION-16741 SDK-commons CVE change analysis (httpclient5/jsoup/jackson)
description: Assess PR #51/#52 (feature/ION-16741_OWASP_FIXES_OCT_REL, v1.R.01.027/028) merged to develop against the ION-12310 SDK-commons feature branch and prior analysis docs. Focus: httpclient5 5.6.4 gzip double-decoding concern (visibility/partner-integrator vs ocean-schedules), jsoup 1.23.2 residual HIGH, jackson 2.21.6 resolution. Assess only, no rebase/staging.

entries.summary: httpclient5 5.6.4 gzip double-decode CONFIRMED as verified prod regression (ION-16417/ION-16792); ocean-schedules assertion is coincidental not causal
entries.detail:
mercury-services doc partner-integrator/docs/2026-09-03-pise-out-gzip-issue-analysis.md (ION-16417) proves: httpclient5 5.6.4 (5.5+ content-compression rewrite, new DecompressingEntity path) transparently decompresses Content-Encoding: gzip at transport layer DESPITE Dropwizard disableContentCompression(true); Jersey GZipDecoder then decodes again -> java.util.zip.ZipException: Not in GZIP format. Broke PISE_OUT-qa in prod (first error at 2026-09-03 00:40 deploy). CRITICAL nuance: only manifests in SHADED FAT-JAR at runtime, NOT reactor mvn test -> commons unit tests stay green. Reproduction tests GzipResponseDecodeTest exist in pi-commons AND visibility-commons. Fix pi/visibility applied: remove their 5.6.4 pin to fall back to commons 5.4.4 + suppress CVE-2026-71290 (async TLS hostname bypass) & CVE-2026-40542 (SCRAM) since Dropwizard uses classic/sync client + bearer auth.

ocean-schedules: collector uses plain JAX-RS ClientBuilder.newClient()/injected Client (APIClient WebTarget), NOT commons JerseyClientModule Dropwizard gzip-enabled path -> no second GZipDecoder stacked -> unaffected. Dev's rationale ('only non-AWS-upgraded module using cloud-sdk') is coincidental, NOT the real cause. Real determinant = ships 5.6.4 AND uses Dropwizard gzip-enabled Jersey client vs a gzip-returning endpoint.

KEY RISK: if commons (feature branch) bumps httpclient5 to 5.6.4, it REMOVES the 5.4.4 fallback that pi & visibility fixes depend on -> RE-BREAKS them and widens blast radius to every Dropwizard-gzip service. Recommendation: keep 5.4.4 in sdk-commons, suppress the two async/SCRAM CVEs (unreachable). PR#51's commons httpclient5 5.6.4 bump on develop is dangerous and likely re-introduces the prod regression.</detail>

entries.detail: Delivered docs/2026-09-09-sdk-commons-cve-change-analysis.md. Conclusions: (1) httpclient5 5.6.4 = reject; keep 5.4.4 on feature branch; PR#51 commons bump likely re-breaks pi/visibility (removes 5.4.4 fallback their fix relies on). Stay OWASP-clean by suppressing CVE-2026-71290 (async TLS) + CVE-2026-40542 (SCRAM), both unreachable on classic/sync+bearer stack. (2) jsoup already 1.23.2 on branch; 1.23.2 clears MEDIUM CVE-2026-71497 but HIGH CVE-2026-75140 has no released fix -> dated suppression, preferred delete orphaned jsoup. (3) Jackson already 2.21.6 via jackson-bom import on branch (ahead of PR#51, equal to PR#52) -> no rebase; app-side bumps still needed downstream (visibility 2.22.2). (4) ocean-schedules unaffected because it uses plain JAX-RS ClientBuilder.newClient(), not Dropwizard gzip JerseyClientModule - dev's 'non-AWS-upgraded' rationale is coincidental not causal. No rebase, no staging performed - only the new untracked doc added.

entries.summary: Validated recommendation to add jackson-databind as a direct dep in commons; sound but should include jackson-core/annotations too
entries.detail:
Verified in code: (1) commons/pom.xml re-declares httpcore5, httpcore5-h2, gson, httpclient5, jetty-server et al. as DIRECT deps to force safe versions into the flattened published POM. (2) jackson-databind is NOT re-declared — it only appears as <exclusion> under jackson-dataformat-csv (line 306) and jackson-datatype-joda (line 410). (3) The jackson 2.21.6 pin lives in the ROOT pom.xml <dependencyManagement> via jackson-bom import (lines 111-117), inherited into commons — NOT in commons' own dependencyManagement (which only holds httpcomponents, lines 30-70). (4) commons flatten-maven-plugin uses DEFAULT flatten mode (NOT flattenDependencyMode=all), which strips <dependencyManagement> from the published POM. => The jackson-bom pin governs commons' OWN build but never reaches consumers; consumers resolve databind transitively via commons->dropwizard-core at DW's version, not 2.21.6. So the user's diagnosis is CORRECT and matches the httpcore5/gson 'trap'. Recommendation to add databind as direct dep at ${jackson.version} is consistent and correct. REFINEMENT: declare jackson-core + jackson-annotations as direct deps too (not databind alone) to avoid split-version skew (databind 2.21.6 depth-1 vs core/annotations transitive at DW version) and to fully mirror the two-piece httpcore5+httpcore5-h2 pattern. Caveats user raised are accurate: (a) self-managing consumers (booking, visibility import jackson-bom / pin databind) still override via their own dependencyManagement regardless of depth -> per-app bumps still required; (b) nearest-wins gives unmanaged consumers commons' depth-1 2.21.6. No code change made — assessment only.</detail>

entries.summary: Implemented jackson direct-dep fix in commons; clean install PASS; flattened POM confirmed carries databind/core 2.21.6 + annotations 2.21; not committed
entries.detail: commons/pom.xml: added jackson-databind, jackson-core, jackson-annotations as DIRECT deps (versions omitted, inherited from root jackson-bom import). Initial attempt hardcoded ${jackson.version}=2.21.6 and FAILED build: jackson-annotations:2.21.6 does not exist on Maven Central (annotations tracks its own version). Fixed by omitting versions (mirrors existing jetty-server direct-dep pattern). README.md v1.0.34-SNAPSHOT section: added item 4 documenting the direct-dep fix and why versions are BOM-inherited. Version stays 1.0.34-SNAPSHOT (already the in-flight uncommitted release; not re-bumped). Build: `mvn clean install` full reactor BUILD SUCCESS, all tests PASS (cloud-sdk-api, cloud-sdk-aws, dynamo-integration-test built first; resumed `mvn install -rf :commons` -> commons 193 wtg tests + others all green, dynamo-client/email-sender/local-*/wtg-federation SUCCESS). Verified flattened_pom.xml now contains: jackson-databind 2.21.6, jackson-core 2.21.6, jackson-annotations 2.21 as direct deps at depth 1 -> pin now reaches consumers. NOT committed - awaiting user review/confirmation. Note: uncommitted working tree also contains prior rebase changes (jsoup removal, httpclient5 5.6.4->5.4.4) from the same in-flight 1.0.34 release.
